title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.7 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 19:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 337 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

The Sun's behaving itself. ☀️

Solar images show a few bright active regions and a broad coronal-hole-like area; no clearly unusual outward structure is visible.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
